description: Known coverage gaps of the cross-language run, accepted by the orchestrator. The matrix lists them; rows marked N/A must each have an entry under rows.

rows.shared_objects.negative.state_problems: Only the Rust adapter produces this negative: it writes profile-invalid changes with raw Automerge, while the TypeScript adapter writes through the profile API, which refuses them. Both consumers check the Rust-produced case.
rows.schedules.minimizer: A unit check of the consumer's delta-debugging minimizer. The TypeScript adapter does not run schedules yet: sdk-ts has the section model (SectionReplica, used by src/sections-ts.ts), and wiring it to the schedule runs (LFCP-02-024) is pending. Until then every direction with TypeScript as producer of histories or as consumer is N/A. sdk-rs writes and replays the recorded seeds (Rust → Rust) and runs the seeds the TypeScript side generates (TS → Rust).
rows.schedules.random: The producer writes each seed's history and deliveries; only sdk-rs does yet, so TS → Rust is N/A too. The TypeScript adapter does not run schedules yet: sdk-ts has the section model (SectionReplica, used by src/sections-ts.ts), and wiring it to the schedule runs (LFCP-02-024) is pending. Until then every direction with TypeScript as producer of histories or as consumer is N/A. sdk-rs writes and replays the recorded seeds (Rust → Rust) and runs the seeds the TypeScript side generates (TS → Rust).
rows.schedules.regressions: Replays the minimized regressions kept in regressions/sections-regressions.json (none recorded yet). The TypeScript adapter does not run schedules yet: sdk-ts has the section model (SectionReplica, used by src/sections-ts.ts), and wiring it to the schedule runs (LFCP-02-024) is pending. Until then every direction with TypeScript as producer of histories or as consumer is N/A. sdk-rs writes and replays the recorded seeds (Rust → Rust) and runs the seeds the TypeScript side generates (TS → Rust).

general: Mode A counts per suite come from sdk-ts only. sdk-rs reports one count over its whole `cargo test --all-features` run, which includes both vector suites, the Automerge corpus and the schema fixtures.
The G-EP7 cross-check (rebuilding the state without a unit that a later Key Epoch Record places beyond its cutoff) is deferred: the run does not compare the two SDKs on it.
